scripts.text: SELECT * FROM metadata.ingestion_configuration WHERE is_run = 1 AND source_name = 'adls';

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT * FROM metadata.ingestion_configuration WHERE is_run = 1 AND source_name = 'sql_db';

sqlReaderQuery.value:
@concat(
'SELECT * FROM dbo.',
item().source_file_name,
' WHERE [',
item().load_indentifier_column,
'] > CAST((',
'SELECT load_identifier_value FROM metadata.ingestion_configuration ',
'WHERE source_file_name = ''',
item().source_file_name,
''') AS ',
item().load_identifier_datatype,
')'
)

text.value: UPADTE metadata.ingestion_configuration SET load_identifier_value = @{activity('get_identifier_value').output.firstRow.identifier_value} WHERE id = @{item().id};

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT source_name  FROM metadata.ingestion_configuration WHERE is_run = 1;

sqlReaderQuery.value: SELECT IsRun FROM metadata.PipelineStatus WHERE PipelineName = '@{pipeline().Pipeline}' AND IsActive = 1;

text.value: UPDATE metadata.PipelineStatus SET IsRun = 1 WHERE PipelineName = '@{pipeline().Pipeline}';

UPDATE metadata.PipelineStatus
SET
    IsRun = 0,
    Status = 'Succeeded',
    StartTime = '@{pipeline().TriggerTime}',
    EndTime = '@{utcNow()}',
    RunDuration = DATEDIFF(
        SECOND,
        '@{pipeline().TriggerTime}',
        '@{utcNow()}'
    )
WHERE PipelineName = '@{pipeline().Pipeline}';

UPDATE metadata.PipelineStatus
SET
    IsRun = 0,
    Status = 'Faileded',
    StartTime = '@{pipeline().TriggerTime}',
    EndTime = '@{utcNow()}',
    RunDuration = DATEDIFF(
        SECOND,
        '@{pipeline().TriggerTime}',
        '@{utcNow()}'
    )
WHERE PipelineName = '@{pipeline().Pipeline}';
